A multi-vehicle crash in Abu Dhabi went viral after footage showed how rubbernecking triggered a dangerous pile-up, injuring five people and damaging seven vehicles.
Abu Dhabi Police released the footage deliberately, emphasising that sharing such videos is essential for raising public awareness of dangerous road behaviour.
Motorists involved in a crash are urged to move their vehicle to the nearest exit or safe location rather than stopping in a traffic lane.
Drivers who stopped to warn oncoming traffic were well-intentioned, but the senior officer cautioned that standing on a motorway can place people at greater risk.
"One second of distraction can cause a serious accident on the highway," said Brig Musallam Al Junaibi, director of traffic violations collection at Abu Dhabi Police's traffic department and patrols.
